boxes.title: Kingship & market enforcement
items: Revived **Balban's** centralised rule, without religious sanction
Four-point plan: fix prices, **state granaries**, end monopolies, separate administration
**Slave boys** made test purchases; cheating merchants punished

boxes.title: Revenue: more
items: ==First Sultan of systematic **land measurement**==; assessed on area + yield
Intermediaries had to pay the **same taxes** as others

boxes.title: Kafur & Warangal: more
head: Point
Detail
rows: **Malik Fakruddin Juna**; beaten by ==**Pothuganti Maili**, **Recherla Venna**==

boxes.title: Effects & debates
items: Espionage + repression bred discontent; dynasty fell soon after **1316**
Controls may have been ==confined to **Delhi**==; hurt merchants + peasants
**Mahmud Gawan** (Bahmani) later used dagh, chehra, land measurement
